notes: Reference date 2018-02-27. Both documents are in force on it: the HR page captured 2018-02-09; the SON guidelines 'Revised December 13, 2017'.

missing = no_policy_on_page under the rule for records with no governing document (reader instructions §3): neither usable source is a governing document for faculty leave, and neither states any parental, childbirth, adoption or maternity provision. 2018_00_hr_time_off_page is an HR recruiting summary of sick, vacation and holiday accruals for three employee classifications (ONA-represented, AFSCME-represented, Unclassified); it does not name faculty. 2018_01_son_apt_guidelines_rev_dec2017 is the School of Nursing promotion and tenure procedure manual (dossier preparation, external review, voting); it contains no leave, relief or tenure-clock extension provision. The provisions the HR page does describe (sick and vacation accruals) are coded as c1-c6, all own_accrual, summary_only, with the faculty group left as the page's classification name.

The HR page's version note suggests 'login_required' where no source sets a parental figure; this record follows the later rule for records with no governing document (reader instructions §3), which prescribes 'no_policy_on_page' for this situation. The version note also records that the OHSU Policy Manual ch. 3 and School of Medicine guidelines were intranet-only.

Tenure track (SON only): 'if tenure is not awarded after a period not to exceed 9 years in active status in the tenure track, the faculty member may be continued on a fixed term appointment' (per OHSU Policy 03-150925). This states the probationary limit, not an extension or exclusion for leave; 'active status' is not defined, so no tenure_clock component is coded.
Holidays on the HR page (8 or 9 paid holidays a year) are fixed days, not a leave a parent could take for a birth; not a component.

Cited but not saved: OHSU Policy 03-150925 (tenure-track limit; number as printed); OHSU policies 03-15-020 (Faculty Series and Ranks) and 03-15-025 (Faculty Appointments); OHSU SON Policy and Procedure 60-01.10 (Faculty Appointment Promotion and Tenure, revised March 2017) and its Appendix A; OHSU SON Policy 06-01.10 (Criteria for Appointment, Promotion, and Tenure); SON Policy 50-01.10; Oregon Revised Statute 353.260. None is described as a leave policy.

Calendar: the SON guidelines refer to quarters ('second week of Winter Quarter'; teaching table by 'Quarter /Year'); kind of term stated without length, so calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order. The statement comes from a School of Nursing document only.

Birth parent chain: no counted component (only the own sick-leave accrual, c1-c3, summary_only, groups not shown to include faculty); statutory floor only (FMLA 12, U7). Non-birth parent chain: no counted component; statutory floor only. No sequence links.
